negativeControl.description: preimage byte 0 XORed by 0x01 — MUST be refused. Only the REJECTION is guaranteed; the error string below is incidental, see errorIsIncidental.
negativeControl.errorIsIncidental: Which error appears depends on the MUTATED preimage's top hash byte, so do not assert on it. z[0] <= 0x7e: the script builds a well-formed DER carrying the wrong s for the real sighash, so the signature check fails with a non-empty signature -> SCRIPT_ERR_NULLFAIL. z[0] >= 0x7f: the increment yields a top byte >= 0x80, making the DER INTEGER negative, i.e. non-canonical -> SCRIPT_ERR_SIG_DER_INVALID_FORMAT (a compiled bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 reports the same class as "Non-canonical DER signature"). Measured over single-byte mutations at 7 positions: 7 of 7 rejected, 0 accepted, via exactly those 2 paths. Assert rejection, not the string.
